verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships an official, documented CLI with concrete commands such as `pulumi preview`, `pulumi import`, `pulumi api` and `pulumi do`. It also documents numeric exit codes that scripts and tools can consume, and the docs describe coding agents previewing and deploying code, which supports agent-driven CLI use. Missing for 10: documented structured/JSON output modes for agent consumption, independent hands-on corroboration of AI agents driving the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Pulumi CLI returns numeric exit codes that indicate the result of a command. Scripts, CI/CD systems, and tools can use these codes
The pulumi api command lets you call any Pulumi Cloud REST API
Show a preview of updates to a stack’s resources... No changes to the stack will actually take place.
write, preview, and deploy code with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents.
